g.text: SPI0 pins: SCK GP18, RX GP16, TX GP19, CSn GP17; values from pico.h in Pico SDK 2.1.1).

g.desc: SPI0 pins: SCK GP18, RX GP16, TX GP19, CSn GP17; values from pico.h in Pico SDK 2.1.1).

g.text: So SCK P0.20 -> GP18, COPI P0.22 -> GP16 (the Pico's RX), CIPO P0.24 <- GP19 (the Pico's TX).

g.desc: So SCK P0.20 -> GP18, COPI P0.22 -> GP16 (the Pico's RX), CIPO P0.24 <- GP19 (the Pico's TX).

g.text: Direction wording (COPI = controller out, peripheral in; CIPO = the reverse; older names MOSI/MISO) is our reading of which side is the controller; the code does not say it outright.
